description: The line plot illustrates the relative change in performance, measured as a percentage, for different quantization methods applied to the Mistral-7B-v0.2-Instruct model across various layers. The x-axis represents the layers of the model, ranging from Layer1-4 to Layer29-32, and the y-axis shows the relative change in performance, with values ranging from -25% to 5%. The plot includes four lines, each representing a different quantization method: LB-Avg of 2×tokens, 8-bit (yellow line with circle markers), LB-Avg of 1×tokens, 16-bit (red line with square markers), RULER4k of 2×tokens, 8-bit (blue line with circle markers), and RULER4k of 1×tokens, 16-bit (dark blue line with square markers). Additionally, there is a baseline line for 4×tokens, 4-bit (grey dashed line). The plot shows that the performance change varies significantly across different layers and quantization methods, with some layers experiencing a decrease in performance, while others show an increase. The baseline line remains relatively stable across the layers.
